description: Following up on dec-1776896273747118927 (accepted option A on 2026-04-23). The edge-drift consistency check (computeInitiativeEdgeSuggestions in overview/consistency.go) currently runs only when overview is explicitly queried, so drift accumulates silently. Fix scope: (1) run the consistency check on every mutation that could affect edges — item create / edit / move / delete, initiative edit, initiative create / delete; (2) the response to that mutation includes a drift field with new missing_explicit / possibly_stale deltas caused by this specific edit; (3) each drift entry carries a suggested one-step fix (concrete CLI command or UI button); (4) CLI prints drift human-readably after success; UI surfaces it inline after save; (5) add a vetted mark / depends_on_reason persistence so legitimately-architectural possibly_stale edges can be suppressed from repeat flagging without losing the edge itself. Goal: catch drift at the source instead of discovering it quarterly.
name: swarm-manager-edge-drift-mutation-time-check
title: Swarm-Manager — Run Edge-Consistency Check On Every Edge-Affecting Mutation, Surface Drift On Response
